summary: Nvni Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the second edition of its internal 'Nuvini AI Prize', an employee competition aimed at promoting AI adoption across its portfolio companies. There are no financial terms, no securities offered, no merger, acquisition, tender offer, or any corporate transaction. The filing is a routine disclosure of a non-material internal initiative. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory process is mentioned. This is an ordinary current report of a foreign private issuer not constituting a special situation.
